question: Can 32-row independent batch items retain R125's complete identity while recovering efficient large-M parallelism?

fixed_inputs.extension_description: Exact R122b rank-3/broadcast descriptor on the R123 developer-mode build
fixed_inputs.strategy_description: Exact natural source-M32 strategy from R123/R124

screen.procedure: Run a fresh same-build no-override control, health-check, then a fresh source-M32 override candidate. Inputs are padded once outside timed regions; copy/allocation cost is deliberately deferred until the kernel mechanism passes.

correctness: One row-0 class across all M for both shapes.
Every output equals the corresponding M=512 prefix.
Batched M=512 equals 16 sequential M=32 calls.
M=200 permutation and repeat are exact.
Changing the 168-row tail padding from zeros to random values does not change real rows.
gates.latency: For each shape, candidate fixed-M32 latency divided by control natural flattened-M latency has geometric mean <=1.15 and no timed point >1.50x.
gates.on_pass: Expand to all six production shapes and separately measure allocation/copy cost with reusable buffers before implementing production source.
gates.on_failure: Close oneDNN descriptor/strategy compositions and proceed to a purpose-built fused batched SYCL/ESIMD kernel.
gates.health: Stop on any new Xe fault, reset, timeout, hang, coredump, or device loss.
